rows.label: tlk70000047_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Watching all of you work so hard has
opened my eyes...

rows.label: tlk70000047_03_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm ashamed to admit it, but until now
I've been escaping into the salvation
called faith.

rows.label: tlk70000047_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But from now on, I'll think about what
I can actually do for her...

rows.label: tlk70000047_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm going to live alongside her and
her illness for the rest of our lives.

rows.label: tlk70000047_03_msg0005
rows.name:
But if things ever become hopeless,
I'll ask a trusted person for help,
not turn to faith.
